## Topics covered

- Ecommerce engineering: WooCommerce, Shopify Plus, BigCommerce, custom plugins, checkout, catalog, and search architecture.
- Integrations and automation: APIs, webhooks, queues, ERP, ShipStation, Finale Inventory, Salesforce, n8n, and Make.
- Infrastructure and performance: Linux, AWS, DigitalOcean, Nginx, Redis, Cloudflare, and Core Web Vitals.
- Custom software: Python, FastAPI, React, Retool, warehouse scanning, and operational tooling.
